summary: Organize the subject around an expressive pose, clear feature hierarchy and playful contrast of large and small shapes.
objective: The action reads when paused at key poses; squash or stretch, if chosen, does not imply that a factual rigid mechanism deforms.
intent_signals: Create a cartoon character or scene
example_prompts: Design a cartoon forest guardian that notices a visitor and waves with a readable arm gesture.

principles: Organize the subject around an expressive pose, clear feature hierarchy and playful contrast of large and small shapes.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Simplify small anatomical or mechanical detail into readable groups while retaining the joints needed by the intended movement.
Use separated local colors and controllable broad highlights; outlines are an option rather than the definition of the look.
Stage a readable gesture before adding secondary motion; keep the camera where the expression and action can both be seen.
observable_checks: The action reads when paused at key poses; squash or stretch, if chosen, does not imply that a factual rigid mechanism deforms.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

known_limits: Proposed art direction only; no rendered artifact, runtime improvement or perceptual validation has been observed for this record.
Appearance choices do not certify factual geometry, material measurements or simulated behavior.
creative_affordances: Combine with cel shading, toy proportions or hand-painted accents; keep factual labels and state transitions independent of the performance.
Adapt this proposal to the explicit user brief; combine or depart from it while preserving any factual and interaction contracts.
